subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this PR's narrow run/harness/context bucket advice, the broader all-millisecond-duration policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or defer changing exported bucket defaults?
rationale: Both open PRs use the supported OpenTelemetry advice mechanism, but they encode different default bucket policies with different compatibility blast radius for existing operator dashboards and alerts.

options.title: Adopt the narrow policy here
options.body: Use this PR's three-histogram change after redacted real OTel export proof, keeping the blast radius tied to the reported run/harness/context problem.

options.title: Adopt the broader duration policy
options.body: Use the broader related PR or a replacement if maintainers want OTel duration buckets to match the Prometheus-style duration policy across all millisecond duration histograms.

options.title: Defer bucket defaults
options.body: Keep collector-side configuration as the supported path until diagnostics owners settle a documented default bucket policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow policy here
recommendation.body: Use this PR's three-histogram change after redacted real OTel export proof, keeping the blast radius tied to the reported run/harness/context problem.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent OpenTelemetry migration history on the affected diagnostics-otel service and test files.
